"'''The Great Gomgourd Quest / A Sticky Situation'''" is the eighth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Official description==
''Nubs recovers a stolen harvest. Kai must face a fear.''
